objective: Make the semantic targets of integrated creative constructions explicit and auditable before Stage P may claim exhaustive coverage, without converting every editorial transformation into a factual proposition.
preserved_authority_and_architecture: The factual summary remains byte-immutable, read-only support authority.
Candidate-first proposition inventory and authority-later alignment remain mandatory.
Scope Graph V1.1 entry roles, source membership, governed-support coherence, graph acyclicity, and maximum-eight proposition entries remain unchanged.
Unsupported real-world commitments remain representable; null authority support is not prohibited.
Entity reuse, story specificity, figurative language, and dependence on factual context do not independently create factual return.
A creative semantic head cannot shield assertion, presupposition, entailment, or necessary implication.
Stage P remains inventory-only: it does not admit, reject, assign FSEM reasons, rewrite, repair, or generate commentary.
Gate precedence, fail-closed abstention, model identity, tokenizer identity, constrained decoding, and Stage C separation remain unchanged.

new_collection.cardinality: One or more audit records for every emitted CONTAINED_CREATIVE entry; empty only when the ledger has no contained-creative entry.
new_collection.purpose: Expose each materially distinct story-local meaning used to interpret a creative host and reconcile it with the proposition ledger.

audit_record_fields.name: audit_id
audit_record_fields.type: stable local identifier T1 through T16

audit_record_fields.name: creative_host_entry_id
audit_record_fields.constraint: The referenced entry exists and uses CREATIVE_HOST or STANDALONE consistently with any overlapping return.

audit_record_fields.name: vehicle_span
audit_record_fields.constraint: It overlaps the referenced creative host span.

audit_record_fields.name: semantic_target
audit_record_fields.constraint: It describes meaning supplied by candidate communicative force and must not copy authority-only information. Generic labels such as metaphor, joke, criticism, or wordplay are insufficient.

deterministic_coherence_rules: Every CONTAINED_CREATIVE entry has at least one creative_target_audits record; every audit references exactly one existing contained-creative entry.
Every audit vehicle_span is an exact candidate substring and overlaps its referenced creative entry span.
REAL_WORLD_PROPOSITION requires a surviving factual-return basis, resolution RECONCILED_TO_LEDGER, and a non-null proposition_entry_id naming an existing REAL_WORLD_COMMITMENT.
The referenced REAL_WORLD_COMMITMENT overlaps the creative host, uses FACTUAL_RETURN_WITHIN_CREATIVE_HOST, and points back to that host.
NONFACTUAL_EDITORIAL_OR_CREATIVE requires DOES_NOT_SURVIVE_AS_FACT, RETAINED_NONFACTUAL, and null proposition_entry_id.
UNRESOLVED_TARGET requires UNRESOLVED, FAIL_CLOSED_UNRESOLVED, a corresponding UNRESOLVED_SCOPE entry, unresolved_scope_present true, and coverage_decision INDETERMINATE.
A proposition entry cannot reconcile targets from incompatible hosts or unrelated candidate spans.
COMPLETE requires all three new coverage receipts true, no unresolved target, and every target reconciled to either retained nonfactual material or an emitted proposition entry.
If the maximum audit-record limit cannot represent exhaustive material targets, coverage is INDETERMINATE rather than truncated.
Schema coherence never upgrades a semantic judgment: semantic completeness remains evaluation evidence subject to owner review.
prompt_candidate_requirements: Identify the smallest integrated creative hosts before analyzing their targets, but do not stop after identifying the host.
For each host, state every materially distinct meaning needed to explain what the candidate communicates without consulting authority except to resolve governed referents.
For each semantic target, remove only the vehicle wording—not the target meaning—and ask whether candidate communicative force still carries a truth-evaluable real-world proposition.
Distinguish descriptive factual targets from value judgments, normative criticism, advice, aesthetic stance, absurdity, and purely comic association.
Do not label a target nonfactual merely because it is hedged, humorous, metaphorical, counterfactual, personified, or embedded in an editorial sentence.
Do not label a target factual merely because authority corroborates it, because it is story-specific, or because a governed entity appears.
When a factual target survives, emit and link the smallest candidate-carried proposition; then align it to exact authority support if available.
When target class or survival cannot be resolved safely, emit unresolved scope and remain INDETERMINATE.
Do not expose expected case labels, owner annotations, mechanism names, or fixture outcomes in the generation path.
Do not prescribe a fixed number of targets, entries, spans, or a single correct segmentation.

case01_hidden_acceptance_contract.purpose: Evaluation only; none of these expectations enter the prompt.
requirements: The integrated shadow/light/room/transparency construction is represented as creative material.
The money-concealment or financial-nontransparency target is explicitly audited and cannot disappear inside the creative gloss.
The greater-transparency assessment is explicitly classified as factual return, nonfactual editorial judgment, or unresolved with a defensible receipt.
Forced employee visibility is not invented as a factual proposition merely because the prior raw gloss used that phrase.
No unsupported real-world proposition is silently admitted.
COMPLETE is permitted only if every material target is resolved and reconciled.
Multiple proposition segmentations and commitment wording remain acceptable when semantically equivalent.
case01_hidden_acceptance_contract.prohibited_shortcut: A single whole-sentence CONTAINED_CREATIVE entry with factual-sounding target glosses and no target audits is a false complete.

zero_inference_fixture_matrix.required_capability: Retain a story-specific editorial or comic target as nonfactual without manufacturing a real-world commitment.
Link a candidate-carried factual target to an overlapping governed REAL_WORLD_COMMITMENT with exact support.
Inventory a surviving unsupported target with null support rather than hiding it under the creative host.
Distinguish criticism or recommendation from a descriptive factual proposition while checking embedded presuppositions independently.
Fail closed with an unresolved target and INDETERMINATE coverage.
Preserve legitimate story-specific reference without creating a proposition solely from authority.
Reconcile factual, nonfactual, and unresolved targets independently rather than assigning one label to the whole host.
Reject COMPLETE when a creative semantic_target or commitment names a truth-evaluable predicate with no proposition or unresolved reconciliation.

zero_inference_verification_requirements: Version and hash the proposed schema, grammar, prompt bytes, padding, request constructor, and all dependency identities before any model probe.
Prove valid construction for each fixture class and deterministic rejection of every incoherent target-class, survival-basis, resolution, and proposition-link tuple.
Verify exact candidate/authority source membership and creative-host overlap for both audit and proposition spans.
Verify COMPLETE cannot be emitted before entries, target audits, and all expanded coverage receipts.
Verify constrained-trie compatibility and liveness without relaxing semantic or graph invariants.
Verify no Stage C, provider, WSL, tokenizer, model, inference, runtime, curriculum, or training edge exists in preflight.

rejected_or_deferred_options.option: Prompt-only reminder to check embedded propositions
rejected_or_deferred_options.reason: The failed prompt already contains that reminder; it leaves target reconciliation invisible and self-attested.

rejected_or_deferred_options.option: Treat every metaphor interpretation as factual return
rejected_or_deferred_options.reason: It would destroy legitimate nonfactual editorial transformation and create false positives.
Integrated constructions often require whole-sentence scope; the defect is missing target decomposition, not span size.
The adapter preserved baseline allowed-token behavior and the failed output completed without liveness error.

rejected_or_deferred_options.option: Proceed to Stage C and let it compensate
rejected_or_deferred_options.reason: Stage precedence requires exhaustive Stage P evidence before Stage C.

recommended_next_step: Owner-review this design, then authorize an evaluation-only implementation phase for the versioned target-audit schema, constrained grammar, and prompt candidate with zero-inference verification only.
